en.headline: McDonald’s Hong Kong suspends shrimp burgers after Taiwan finds banned antibiotic
en.dek: The local operator said its shrimp patties come from a different Thai production batch and recipe, but paused sales of the Ebi range as a precaution to address public concern.
body: McDonald’s Hong Kong has temporarily suspended sales of its entire Ebi Burger series, including the standard, double and pineapple variants, after Taiwan McDonald’s withdrew two similar shrimp burgers following detection of a banned synthetic antibiotic.

Taiwan authorities reported that random batch testing of imported shrimp patties found 0.7 parts per billion of nitrofurans and their metabolites, which do not comply with local food-safety rules. Nitrofurans are synthetic antibiotics prohibited for use in food-producing animals in many jurisdictions, including Hong Kong.

McDonald’s Hong Kong said it had checked with its global supplier in Thailand and confirmed that the formulation and production batches used for the Hong Kong products differ from those supplied to Taiwan. The company stated that it strictly complies with local food-safety regulations and took the precautionary step to ease public concern.

The Centre for Food Safety lists nitrofurans among substances that must not be present in food of animal origin. The Hong Kong operator did not report any detection in its own products. Crab burger items remained available.

zh.headline: 台麥當勞蝦堡驗出禁用抗生素 港方預防性停售滋味蝦堡系列
zh.dek: 香港麥當勞指本地蝦餅配方及批次與台灣不同，為釋除公眾疑慮即時暫停出售相關產品。
body: 台灣麥當勞兩款新推出的海味揚蝦堡及雙層揚蝦堡，因進口蝦排檢出人工合成抗生素硝基呋喃及其代謝物，含量達0.7ppb，不符合當地法規，已全面停售。香港麥當勞隨即宣佈預防性暫停出售「滋味蝦堡」系列，包括普通、雙層及菠蘿口味。
香港麥當勞表示，已向位於泰國的全球供應商核查，確認本港出售的蝦堡所使用的蝦餅製作配方及批次均與台灣不同，一直嚴格遵守本地食品安全法規。為釋除公眾疑慮及令顧客安心，決定即時暫停出售相關系列產品。
硝基呋喃屬合成抗生素，本港《食物內有害物質規例》將其列為禁止在食用動物中使用的獸藥，在動物肌肉及內臟中屬不可檢出成分。香港麥當勞未有表示本地產品檢出問題，同屬新品的蟹堡則繼續有售。
